subjectLine: Critical Exploits in Cisco, Microsoft, and Palo Alto Networks Devices

articles.title: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Actively Exploited
articles.summary: Cisco has issued a warning about an unpatched zero-day vulnerability in its Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, which is being actively exploited in the wild.

articles.title: New Russia-Linked GREYVIBE Group Targets Ukraine with AI-Powered Cyberattacks
articles.summary: A new, previously undocumented threat actor named GREYVIBE, believed to be Russian-speaking and aligned with Kremlin interests, has been actively targeting Ukraine since August 2025.

articles.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Vulnerability Actively Exploited
articles.summary: Cisco has issued a warning that a high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-20245) in its Catalyst SD-WAN Manager is under active exploitation.

articles.title: Chrome V8 Zero-Day Exploited in the Wild
articles.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in Chrome's V8 engine is being actively exploited in the wild. Google has released a security update to address the issue.

articles.title: CISA Orders US Agencies to Patch Check Point VPN Bug
articles.summary: CISA has given US government agencies three days to patch a critical vulnerability in Check Point's Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access deployments.

articles.title: AI Discovers 21 Zero-Days in FFmpeg; Chrome Patches Record 429 Bugs
articles.summary: An AI agent has identified 21 previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities in FFmpeg, a widely used media processing library. Concurrently, Google released Chrome 149 with patches for an unprecedented 429 security bugs.

articles.title: Microsoft Patches Record 206 Flaws, Including Three Zero-Days and Critical RCE Bugs
articles.summary: Microsoft has patched a record 206 security vulnerabilities, including three zero-days and critical RCE bugs.

articles.title: CISA Adds Exploited SolarWinds Serv-U DoS Flaw to KEV Catalog
articles.summary: CISA has added a critical denial-of-service vulnerability (CVE-2026-28318) in SolarWinds Serv-U software to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
